about: The US pack's packets, replacing the core ones with the same id.

packets.title: Yearly adult screen (depression, substance use and food)
packets.about: Every adult, once a year: the short first stage of each screen. A positive answer opens its follow-up: the PHQ-9 after the PHQ-2, TAPS-2 after TAPS-1, the six-item survey after the Hunger Vital Sign. A positive food screen counts in UDS Table 6A (line 40) once it is recorded as a coded problem.

packets.title: After a positive food screen (six-item food security survey)
packets.about: For a positive Hunger Vital Sign: the USDA six-item survey says how severe the food insecurity is.

packets.title: Who we serve: UDS questions and the sliding fee (short annual update)
packets.about: Housing status, agricultural work and veteran status, with household income for the sliding fee. Feeds UDS Tables 3A, 3B and 4 and the 330(g), (h) and (i) Grant Reports.
